name: Native-order joint up/gate K-loop unroll4
description: Preserves the exact native32-lane ordered dot8 accumulations and SIMD sum while unrolling the outer K loop by4. Uses the earlier native-order LUT up/gate kernel, unchanged native down, BF16 projections/bias/SwiGLU and native prefill fallback. No weight/layout/precision/routing change or cache. Tests loop-control/load scheduling on a measured up/gate region; hardware cause and performance unproven.
